In the NE corner of a rectangular cashel (CL004-013002-). A possible hut site (diam. 6m) defined by a low grassy wall.

In the NW interior of a cashel (CL033-020001-). A hut-site (int. diam. 5.55m E-W; 5.5m N-S) defined by a double-faced wall (Wth 1.2m at E) and spill (Wth 2.4-3.2m).

In the SW corner of a cashel (CL004-016021-). An oval hut site (4m NW-SE; 2.5m NE-SW) defined by a wall (Wth 0.9-1.2m; H 0.5-0.7m).

In the W sector of a cashel (CL005-115007-). A rectangular house site (4.3m N-S; 2.7m E-W) defined by a low, grass-covered wall.

Near the centre of a cashel (CL010-004----). An oval hut site (int. dims. 10m N-S; 6.5m E-W) defined by a bank of earth and stone (int. H 0.2-0.3m; ext. H 0.4-0.6m; T 0.6m).

Situated SE of centre in a cashel (CL026-025----) in rough grazing. A cairn (dims. 6m E-W; 4m N-S; H 0.4m).

Date of upload: 3 May 2017

Situated against the inner W face of a cashel (CL009-059090-). The remains of a house (int. dims. 4.7m N-S; 2.5m E-W) defined by curving grass-covered wall-footings (Wth 1-1.6m).

Situated at the E edge of a low plateau, just inside the N perimeter of a cashel (CL033-042----). A hut-site (int. dims. 3m E-W; 2.7m N-S) with an entrance at SE (Wth 0.9m).

Compiled by: Michael Moore

Date of upload: 24 May 2016

Situated at the SE edge of a cashel (CL010-095001-) where it is built against the cashel wall’s inner face, this circular hut site (int. diam. 1.5m) is defined by a tumbled wall (Wth 1.5m; H 0.4-0.6m).

Situated in the NE interior of a cashel (CL009-070001-), this souterrain (L 6.7m; max. Wth 1.2m; max. D 0.4m) is a N-S stone-filled channel with drystone walls on either side.

Situated in the NW quadrant of cashel (CL033-031001-) in a forested area in undulating landscape. An open section of passage (L 5m NNW-SSE; Wth 1m at S to 1.6m at N; D 0.6-0.8m).

Compiled by: Michael Moore

Date of upload: 24 May 2016

Within a cashel (CL004-016012-). Westropp (1901, 10) noted an 'ancient circular hut' in the SW interior, of which there are now no visible remains at ground level.

Within a cashel (CL004-016018-), abutting the perimeter at E. Roughly circular house foundations (5m N-S; 5m E-W) enclosed by a low bank of stone (H 0.4-0.5m).
